summary: Blaize Holdings filed a Form 8-K reporting preliminary Q3 2026 revenue of about $0.5 million, earned in August from hardware sales to a single European customer, alongside a revised full-year 2026 revenue outlook of $32–36 million. The revision reflects shipment timing and working-capital management tied to binding NeoTensr purchase orders under an April 2026 contract worth up to $50 million plus a pending new order from an existing customer. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; this is an earnings/guidance disclosure, not a special situation. Watch inventory procurement and customer concentration risk.
